protocol.bootstrap: test dates resampled with replacement within each fold/holdout; identical draws across cohort models (paired); B=1000, seed 108

cv_holdout_tension.note: Every candidate but the champion scored higher on the single Aug-1->mid-Sep holdout than on 4-fold CV, and holdout vs CV rank models in near-opposite order among trees (RF best CV 0.5167; XGB/LGBM best holdout ~0.56). The holdout is ONE friendly 6-week window used once; the 4 CV folds span 4 months including the adversarial 2026-04. Adjudication: algorithm choice is decided on CV mean + fold minimum (regime robustness); the holdout serves only as a no-catastrophe check. lgbm_fs_selected is the only candidate whose holdout ~= CV (-0.009), i.e. least window-dependent.

verdicts: Chance (pooled CV, date-block bootstrap): clearly above 0.5 only for lgbm_fs_selected, lgbm_fs_selected_clean, lr_l2_clean, random_forest; significantly BELOW 0.5 for baseline_mom_clean, gru (1-feature momentum ranked mildly contrarian in this sample); everything else (baseline_mom, decision_tree, lightgbm, lr_elastic, lr_l1, lr_l2, lstm, mlp, rl_reinforce, xgboost) is NOT distinguishable from coin-flipping on CV. On the holdout every model clears 0.5 with P=1.000 -- the friendly-window effect, which is exactly why the holdout alone is not trusted.
Champion vs chance: lgbm_fs_selected pooled-CV AUC 0.5299 (95% CI [0.5216, 0.5388], P(>0.5)=1.0); holdout 0.5219 (CI [0.5141, 0.5301]). A real but thin edge of ~2-3 AUC points.

Champion vs lr_l2: paired CV-mean delta +0.0181 (95% CI [0.0111, 0.0256], P=1.0) -- significant under date-block resampling -- but a dead heat on the holdout (delta -0.0008, P=0.462). CAVEAT: with only 4 CV regime-months the date-block bootstrap conditions on those months and cannot capture fold/regime-level uncertainty, which this sample shows is the dominant risk. The CV gap is treated as suggestive, not settled; the recommendation therefore also rests on stability, cost, interpretability and scale-up headroom.

Champion vs the free floor: paired CV-mean delta +0.0373 (CI [0.0257, 0.049], P=1.0) -- the champion does beat the 1-feature momentum baseline on CV; on the holdout even that gap closes (delta -0.0079, P=0.107).

CV-vs-holdout contradiction (the heart of the adjudication): on CV mean the champion beats xgboost by +0.0284 (CI [0.0195, 0.0365]); on the single holdout xgboost leads by 0.0426 (P(xgb better)=1.000). Both directions are 'significant' under date resampling -- so the disagreement is regime-window dependence, not sampling noise. Four monthly windows outvote one 6-week window; the 5-year run adjudicates for good.

Scale of resolvable differences: individual 95% CIs are roughly +/-0.009-0.012 wide, so unpaired differences of ~0.01-0.02 (the entire mid-table: lr anchors, decision_tree, rl, mlp, lstm, full-feature GBMs on CV) are inside the noise, and paired sub-0.01 differences (champion vs lr_l2 on holdout; l1/l2/elastic among themselves) are too. The mid-table ordering should not be oversold.

secondary_task_caveat.label_defect: label_up_5d hard-codes 0 where fwd_ret_5d is NaN (~1.6% of rows; fixed in the cleaned rebuild)
secondary_task_caveat.verdict: up_5d CV means are inflated by the one-sided 2026-04 fold (base rate 0.72) across all families; used as a sanity check only, never for selection.

data_quality_event.what: 12 phantom holiday-echo days (2.9% of ingested sessions): the archive mirror served the previous session's bhavcopy on 2026 NSE holidays instead of 404ing; every ticker duplicated the prior session's OHLC+volume.
data_quality_event.fix: Ingest patched (2026 holiday calendar + duplicate-day guard), phantom days purged, dataset rebuilt; label_up_5d NaN-encoding fixed in the same rebuild.
data_quality_event.revalidation: Champion and anchors re-run on cleaned data: lgbm_fs_selected CV 0.5307->0.5314 (std 0.018->0.014), lr_l2 0.513->0.517, baseline_mom 0.493->0.491 -- ranking robust. League numbers remain the FROZEN pre-fix runs; the *_clean rows are the robustness check (their test calendars differ, so they are bootstrapped as a separate cohort).

recommendation.decision: Carry LightGBM on the selected 10-feature subset to the 5-year run; keep L2 logistic regression as the interpretable benchmark/sanity layer.

carry_to_5y.algorithm: LightGBM classifier on the 10-feature selected subset (long momentum + delivery block + atr_pct + dist_52w_high + inverted cs_rank_mom_20)
evidence: Best primary CV among candidates: 0.5307 (CI [0.5225, 0.5394]); re-validated on cleaned data at 0.5314 with fold std tightening 0.018->0.014.
Only candidate never below 0.50 in any of the 5 OOS windows (min fold 0.501404; clean rerun min 0.506865); every other model dips below chance in at least one window.
Smallest CV<->holdout gap (-0.0088 vs +0.01..+0.06 for the rest): least regime-window sensitivity -- the property that matters for scale-up.
Top-decile mean 20d excess positive in all 5 windows (+0.96%, +4.58%, +1.02%, +2.82%, +2.12%).
Native missing-value handling for the structurally-NaN long-lookback features early in the 5y history (ret_252d/mom_12_1 are 58% NaN here); ~32s per full protocol run -- cheap at 5y scale.

carry_to_5y.algorithm: L2 logistic regression (C=0.01, all features, harness scaling)
carry_to_5y.role: interpretable benchmark + sanity layer, not a production scorer
evidence: Cheapest credible anchor: a dead heat with the champion on the holdout (delta -0.0008, P=0.462); the champion's paired CV edge over it (+0.0181) is real under date resampling but conditions on only 4 regime-months. Per-1-sd coefficients give a drift monitor the GBM cannot.

Improved on cleaned data (0.513->0.517) and tracks the champion on holdout AUC (0.523), but its holdout decile spread is negative (-0.023: extremes invert economically) and it sat below 0.50 in 2 of 4 folds -- benchmark only.

drop.why: Does not earn its complexity: CV 0.5085, REINFORCE failed to beat its own init on 2/4 folds, and its own portfolio sim loses to the free mom20 heuristic out-of-sample (net +1.76% vs +2.71%/20d CV-agg; +4.67% vs +5.15% holdout).
At or below chance on CV (0.489 / 0.502): a 20-session temporal view adds nothing at this scale, and the MLP (0.5025, ~3 AUC pts under LGBM) shows the deep stack itself isn't paying either.
Strictly dominated by the boosted/bagged trees it underlies.
Numerically identical to lr_l2 to ~3 decimals; keep one linear anchor.

revisit_at_5y_if: Full-feature XGBoost/LightGBM (holdout 0.5646/0.5627, spreads +3.5/+2.9pts, but bottom-tier CV ~0.502-0.504) beat the 10-feature subset on the multi-year walk-forward MEAN, not a single window -- then prefer the full-feature GBM.
The re-run feature selection at 5y (long-lookback features fully populated) changes the subset materially -- re-fit and re-adjudicate.
The champion's mildly negative clean-holdout decile spread (-0.004) persists across multiple years -- then the ranking edge is not monetizable as a long-short.
recommendation.purpose_note: The pilot's question was WHICH ALGORITHM, not whether the edge is tradable: gradient-boosted trees on a compact selected subset is the decisive answer. The SIZE of the edge (pooled-CV AUC ~0.53, and a gap to the linear anchor that vanished on the holdout window) is a 5-year question.

retest_at_5y: Feature selection: re-run the full ranking/elimination at 5y -- ret_252d, mom_12_1, dist_200dma are 58/58/21% NaN in the pilot and 'switch on' through 2026; the top-10 subset may change.
Full-feature GBM vs 10-feature subset: the single friendly holdout favored full-feature XGB/LGBM; adjudicate on ~60 monthly folds where 0.01-0.02 AUC deltas become resolvable.
Significance: re-run the date-block bootstrap (B=1000, seed 108) -- with thousands of test dates the champion-vs-linear gap will be in or out of the noise definitively.
Regime coverage: the pilot had one adversarial month (2026-04); verify the >=0.50 fold floor and decile-spread sign consistency across full bull/bear cycles.
Economics: decile spreads net of costs/turnover on y_excess_20d; confirm top-decile excess positivity by regime, not just by fold.
Secondary task: re-evaluate up_5d with the NaN-label fix and per-regime base-rate stratification before trusting any up_5d number.
Data hygiene: extend the holiday-echo duplicate scan and corporate-action handling to the full 5y ingest (unadjusted prices: y_clean_20d masking must be re-audited).
Optional: one MLP re-check at 5y data volume before finalizing the no-deep verdict.
